title: ERRATUM to AXN:0365 — A Proposed Experiment Cited as an Established Result: Correcting Ground 1 of Deposit #856
creator: Lee Sharks
description: Deposit #856 (The Pristine Fallacy, v1.0) states in Ground 1 that the Reverse Turing Test (#161) "establishes" that AI-habituated writers produce text bearing the statistical signatures of machine cognition in unaided writing. Deposit #161 says of itself, twice, "The paper does not run the experiment. It specifies it." This erratum corrects the evidence status of that citation at its point of use: Ground 1 rests on a specified, unrun protocol, not a result; Grounds 2 and 3 are unaffected; the external literature (Padmakumar & He 2023; Sourati et al. 2026) supports assisted-writing homogenization but does not measure persistent change in unaided writing, which remains the open question #161 was written to test. Canonical bytes of #856 unchanged; registry-level cross-reference per the mechanism of #1554. The defect was identified by an external machine reader in an unprimed traversal on 2026-09-05 and verified against both canonical texts.
